reviews.comment: Professor Cho is amazing! Her expectations on assignments are very clear, and she always leaves comments on your rough draft so that you can improve it for the final submission. We didn't even have class for the last two weeks of the semester, because she'd taught us everything she intended to. She replies pretty quickly to emails, too.

This is for ENGL 306. She's the best professor I've ever had. We read multiple books throughout the semester, but it's worth it. I can honestly say that I'll never forget everything discussed in class. I enjoyed the discussions though controversial, bc she created a safe environment. She's accessible and her assignments aren't hard. TAKE HER CLASS!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Cho has been one of my favorite professors at TAMU. She did a fantastic job of facilitating discussion in class and genuinely seemed interested in hearing what you had to say. She was a tough grader when it came to papers, and sometimes there was a lot of work, but she offered helpful feedback and wanted to see her students be successful.

reviews.comment: She is the most tough grader professor I have had. For this class we had an assignment due EVERY SINGLE Mon., Wed., and Fri. The assignments are not even just busy work and even if she tells you to just try your best on the assignments she will almost never give you an A. We are in a pandemic and she does not care about her students well-being
